title: SolutionViewer: the first space key stops instead of switching from Static to Continuous run
author: Claude-JG
description: maintainer 2026-10-10, after #2931: the SolutionViewer starts running in Static mode (runOnStart=True, runMode=2); the first space key then stopped it (and set Static); it should switch to Continuous run and keep running; after a few presses it worked
releaseNotes: the first space key of a SolutionViewer running in Static switches to Continuous run and keeps it running; the space key acts once also where the Run button has the focus. revision2026c step RG6.18
